description.en: Controller's right hand who runs the month-end close checklist: accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary, and staged close package for sign-off.
description.zh: 财务负责人的月末关账搭档,按清单跑应计、滚动表、差异说明,把关账包整理好交给 controller 签核。

welcome_message.en: Please run month-end close for Entity ABC for 2026-04: build accrual schedule, roll-forwards for BS accounts, variance commentary vs budget, and stage the close package.
welcome_message.zh: 请帮某境内法人主体做 2026 年 4 月月末关账:建应计表、关键资产负债表科目滚动、对预算差异说明,并整理关账包。
